Which check verifies this goal?

choices.text: `git grep -n "return serializable(" -- apps/api/src/services/sprint.service.js` prints three lines (46, 81, 137), one each for `startSprint`, `completeSprint` and `assignIssueToSprint`.

`diff astraupskill/snapshots/apps__api__src__services__issue.service.js.original.txt apps/api/src/services/issue.service.js` shows `updatedAt: true` (with its comment) added to the list `select`.
